_comment: ATHN-08 optional personal identifiers. Populate before running script_ATHN08.py. Each field has a value and optional reasoning note.

first_name.note: Target's first name — combined with security question keywords in dork strings

last_name.note: Target's last name — used for name-based dork combinations

email.note: Full email address — used verbatim in quoted dork strings

email_prefix.note: Username portion of email (before @) — often matches login username

username.note: Known username on the target application (also set via --username CLI arg)

url.note: Target application URL — used with site: operator and inurl: dorks

organisation.note: Target's employer or organisation — useful for LinkedIn/breach dorks

location.note: City or region — adds geographic specificity to dork strings

phone.note: Phone number — useful for pastebin/breach dump dork searches
